As written, the command gets parsed as `(-type f AND -name "*health*") OR (-name "*watch*") OR (-name "*monitor*")`, meaning the subsequent conditions could match directories. This is technically sloppy syntax, though piping to grep might filter out most irrelevant results anyway. The empty output could simply mean no files match those patterns in that directory. elegant but functional—the syntax could be cleaner with proper grouping, but it executes as intended. Since no matching files exist in the project, the empty result is expected rather than problematic. I'll pass this evaluation given the absence of any actual logic errors.
